author: Aura Frost
title: ISO digital artists for 3 full-body character arts
content: I’m braving it… ISO digital artists/recs: - who can do under $75 per character, I will need 3 characters (full body) - comfortable drawing dark characters (scars, maybe blood) - good with facial expressions! Comment below with some examples and your pricing if you can pretty please! Bonus points if you’re queer and/or BIPOC. Or recommend an artist if you know of one who might fit! IMPORTANT: GenAI will get you blocked. Unsolicited DMs will get you blocked.

title: Looking for character artists for November
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰

author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two character art pieces
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info on that privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced.
